authorization_scope: Read-only feasibility review. No decoder implementation or GPU check is approved by this record; a useful standalone SC6 terminal result and root selection remain prerequisites.
new_helpers: State-owned MoE selector and module-reference cache

independent_source_inventory.full_extension_cache_key: _MA_EXTS uses the complete immutable defines tuple after DQ7 insertion; SC6 must be present in that tuple for eligible WGS only.
independent_source_inventory.state_weight_banks: One ma_w list, entries 0..11 shared unchanged across all token sizes, only WGS entries 12/13 optionally compact.

findings: The map covers all active build and timed aliases. Keeping legacy wrappers as dead compatibility code is safe only if no new build closure or timed path still calls them.

ma_sfx and ma_sc6 must be computed once from the same actual W13/W2 tensors before either build threads or packing; ma_sc6 must imply PRMT. Eligible, PRMT-only and non-PRMT states must coexist without updating ambient encoding globals.

The new selector must reproduce the TINY2 guard directly from state-owned ma_sfx, rather than call the old global _moe_tiny2_ok(). It must use current decoder tuples, including MULDEC1 and the tiny FINPF difference from standalone.

Preserve _moe_build initial PDL=0 behavior for state-loaded module refs and the existing _after_attention setter immediately before launches. Module refs may be shared across states with identical complete keys; this is not a claim of concurrent runtime safety beyond the existing contract.
Keep selector choice based on original T for every chunk, including T385 -> 384+1. Dense UV physical 2T does not change the T-row MoE input or selector.

Compact WGS entries can remain in the one ma_w list because all non-WGS natural-fat aliases remain dormant under WGMIN9 and unchanged define tuples. This needs an explicit source/preprocessor proof in the eventual port.
No routing, Marlin packing/fallback, scratch, guards, PDL device instructions, dense/attention kernels, UV/SK2B/UB2 fusion, autotuner policy or chunk launch arguments need changes.

The unchanged tuner catches agent launch failures. A clean official decoder PASS alone could therefore describe Marlin fallback; activation evidence and successful SC6 resource markers remain necessary before attributing performance to this mechanism.
future_source_proof_requirements: Restore all six scoped edits and three helpers to exact decoder parent AST; normalize only the known BIGM comment when comparing embedded standalone CUDA.
Exercise actual decoder _POS_PACK packing and reconstruct full W13/W2 scale bytes without copying standalone dual-layout APIs.
Execute actual threaded build closures with captured state/representative M values to catch late-bound lambda variables; retain joins and error propagation.
Alternate eligible, PRMT-only and non-PRMT prepared states across threshold boundaries and T385. Poison legacy global aliases to expose accidental dependence.
Verify all non-WGS compile tuples and generated source remain identical, and SC6 does not enter generic ma_sfx.
Exercise agent and Marlin branches, exact PDL setters, resource failure/fallback behavior, and unchanged per-chunk launch arguments.
Retain bounded weight-only eligibility logging if needed for activation evidence, but do not add runtime phase detection or new tuning.

prefix_sanity_review.decision: Feasible low-priority small experiment, with low confidence in speed benefit; no implementation approved here.
prefix_sanity_review.source_contract: Full x-producer warp for WGSPR1 or compute warp0 for WGSPR0 executes the same chunked integer scan. Only lane0 retains the existing binary searches/debug block. Preserve both internal publication sync and caller join/sync.
prefix_sanity_review.arithmetic: Parent A/B cost coefficients and uint32 prefixes are exact for nj up to 88, with zero-padded final chunks; grid132 products remain below 2^32. No global-zero-job support follows from a valid zero-length prefix.
prefix_sanity_review.measurement_limit: Saved ef7 after-gather to after-join gaps are 0..64ns (median32ns per input). This supplies no positive exposed-prefix-stall evidence, but is not a causal upper bound on issue/shared contention or compiler effects.
prefix_sanity_review.selection: Allow a cheap fixed source-local test if root selects it after SC6. Do not require a large whole-decoder gain, but do not justify it using donor latency claims or combine it silently with SC6. No preliminary GPU campaign or expanded scheduler rewrite is warranted.
